historical_package_observation.observation: An older exact package let Generate plan advance to Review without a coordinator and then showed an error. No provider ran.

current_product_source.implementation: plan_configuration_available requires a non-empty goal and a coordinator ID present in registered profiles; the Generate plan button includes that predicate in its enabled state.

observations: With a registered agent and no coordinator, Generate plan remained disabled and showed coordinator not registered.
Write plan manually opened three empty task rows immediately without starting a process or contacting an LLM.
Confirming the incomplete plan was rejected with invalid task identity, agent, prompt, scope or test command; the registered executable was not invoked.
exact_package_ui.result: passed for the QAS-29 coordinator gate and safe incomplete-plan rejection

scope: The regression is fixed at source level and verified in the exact v0.1.37 package. Manual planning created three empty tasks without an LLM or process; confirming the incomplete draft was rejected before invoking the registered executable. No product code changed in this verification.
